page.layout: One column of running text, set in roman and italic, with the page number at the head. No running head, marginal notes or footnotes. Left margin shows only show-through and stains, which are left out. At the foot, right of the last line, the word "Sic" stands alone as a catchword.

main_text.l: tiquorumque instituto illis contradita fuis-
se, & communi omnium calculo diffemi-
nata, quæ, licet ringatur Hottingerus, riti-
bus, ac cerimonijs, nec non dogmatibus
Pontificiorum, & Græcorum non absimi-
lia sunt, & hæreticorum recentiorum di-
ctatis maiori ex parte contraria. Quare
detonet Hottingerus quidquid de illis vult,
ac in mentem venerit, non id efficiet, v-
t perpetua Orientalium, & Pontificiorum
veritas infirmetur: eo enim magis foras
pellucebit, quo magis ab infidis occultatur.

l.i: omnia accedere, vel in circumstantijs tantum-
variare, vel vbi Pontificijs videntur fauere-
partibus, illud ex principijs fluere Pontificio-
rum, etiam opinione erroneis. &c. Atque sic
non negamus Orientales Ecclesias cum Romana
aliquid habere fimile, plura tamen nobiscum-.

main_text.l: Quis similia audiit? Si saniori mente rem
considerasset, Hottingerus, respirasset pau-
lulum illius pertinacia, atque temeritas,
aliquid loci, & consilio datum fuisset,
nec in tantam turpitudinem venisset, vt hoc
sibi esset apud integros iudicio viros confi-
tendum. Non erit itaque abs re, si Græco-
rum præcipua producta, neque enim
omnia tempus concedit, conferamus, vt
infra.

page.notes: Printed "tantum-" and "fauere-" and "nobiscum-" end lines with a dash after the word; kept as printed. "audiit" is printed "audijt" (vowel i in j form), corrected to i. "ringatur" and "detonet" read as printed but are doubtful in sense. Long s is printed as s throughout. Bottom-left margin shows show-through only.
